title: Crumb: how are changes in a running Chrome session saved back to the vault?
scope: A running state-mode supervisor: autosave timer, crumb sync/close signals, snapshot, merge, encrypted write.
omissions: Launch, inject and handle startup handshake (launchDetached)
Profile mode, login, capture and check flows

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.description: Detached process that autosaves the session

notes.title: When saves happen
notes.text: setInterval every --autosave s (default 30; 0 disables), SIGUSR2 (crumb sync), final save on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Closing Chrome directly exits with no final save.

notes.title: Merge, skip, best effort
notes.text: Unchanged snapshots are skipped; overlapping saves share one in-flight save. Changes are 3-way merged onto the vault's latest copy, written via temp+rename. Errors are only logged.

notes.title: Sync and close confirmation
notes.text: crumb sync polls the handle up to 10s for a new lastSavedAt and returns without error if nothing changed. crumb close waits 30s, then SIGKILLs, which skips the final save.
